item.futuretinker.wolf_armor.description: Armor built for a wolf: right-click a tamed wolf to put it on, sneak-right-click with an empty hand to take it off.
item.futuretinker.wolf_armor_plating.des: The plate: armour value and toughness come from its material.
item.futuretinker.wolf_armor_lining.desc: The lining: carries the material traits.
item.futuretinker.wolf_armor_binding.des: The binding: holds the armor together and sets how it repairs.
